summary: Restrict route grouping to specific zone IDs.
businessRules: zone_ids defines: An array of IDs associated with custom defined zones to be used for route grouping. Please note: * This parameter is effective only when "zone_source": "custom_definition" * Use the zones attribute…
Each element in zone_ids must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: zones. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
Vehicle and job zones must intersect. Vehicle without zone restrictions can serve any zone.
